items.title: Repair Hermes learning attribution and profile concurrency
acceptance: Outcome reconciliation reads the append-only decision log rather than relying on consumable outbox packets.
Direct and learning Hermes invocations serialize access to shared profile state.
Worker failures preserve actionable child-process diagnostics.
Regression coverage proves durable decision discovery after outbox consumption.

items.title: Give the reasoning agent artificial session memory via a deterministic observation layer
acceptance: The direct worker accumulates a bounded session observation ledger and derives provisional structure, range, regime, volatility, level, and attributable-outcome measurements.
The observation block is injected as measured evidence, is neutral when absent or warming, and can never block a cycle or select an action.
Session continuity does not depend on Hermes self-compaction.
Deterministic unit tests and replay prove schema, persistence, dedupe, pruning, and bounded prompt shape.
One named live Sim session proves the block remains evidence-only and does not create directional, sizing, geometry, or veto behavior.
evidence: 2026-07-31 v0.0.2.18: scripts/market_structure.py, worker wiring, observation contract, and deterministic tests landed.
Replay over 161 real packets produced a bounded session block without requiring model memory.
Issue #2 owns the remaining external Sim acceptance.
items.stop_line: Observations are measurements only: no action selection, sizing, geometry, entry, amendment, exit, or veto may be computed here.

items.title: Equip cognition with consultable market-structure vocabulary
acceptance: Retain useful structure vocabulary without encoded setup preferences, numeric recipes, quotas, or unverified base rates.
evidence: The original implementation mixed useful vocabulary with strategy-shaped point, ATR, scaling, profit-target, location, and pattern priors.
GHP-003 keeps the vocabulary and removes the encoded strategy.
items.stop_line: No deterministic strategy, quota, archetype whitelist, numeric recipe, or auto-geometry may enter any skill.

items.title: Restore intelligence-first cognition and remove encoded trading strategy from the hot path
acceptance: Hot-path profile contains no daily PnL target, account-size-specific contract ceiling, fixed point/ATR recipe, scale ladder, averaging recipe, or mandatory setup preference.
Market-structure skill contains vocabulary and competing hypotheses, not strategy instructions or unverified numeric base rates.
Capacity and supported actions are packet/user configured and authoritative from Glitch.
All contract-supported actions remain available and deliberate inaction remains legitimate judgment.
Source contracts fail if removed strategy phrases or recipes return.
Full profile suite and distribution integrity pass.
evidence: SOUL.md and glitch-trade-mnq define evidence-neutral probabilistic judgment with packet/user-configured authority.
glitch-market-structure retains vocabulary while removing playbooks, fixed recipes, and unverified base rates.
glitch-build-intent preserves strict intent shape and forbids replacing the chosen intent with an unrelated strategy.
tests/test_intelligence_first_contract.py locks the removed strategy phrases and required authority language.
Profile distribution 0.0.2.21 removes unrelated Account.All connectivity from the LLM market-feed gate and has regenerated SHA256SUMS.
items.stop_line: Do not replace the removed recipes with a different strategy, score, quota, or hidden gate.

items.title: Prove the immutable NinjaTrader Hermes profile against the paired Glitch AI artifact
acceptance: One immutable profile manifest is paired with one immutable Glitch AI AddOn artifact.
Install/update, paused-first jobs, status, cognition, delivery, learning, reset, restart continuity, controls, and native receipts pass on the target Windows/NinjaTrader machine.
No hard-coded strategy, hidden observation gate, follower-directed intent, or unauthorized native mutation occurs.
The operator explicitly promotes the named artifact pair.
items.blocked_reason: Requires the target Windows/NinjaTrader/Hermes installation, paired Glitch AI artifact, approved Sim fixtures, and operator promotion.
items.stop_line: No beta-ready, profitability, unattended evaluation, or live-capital claim before paired native acceptance.
